faq_heading: Questions consultants and agencies ask about a LinkedIn outreach agent

faqs.q: Will outreach from an agent hurt my reputation as a consultant?
faqs.a: Not if it is done carefully. Messages are short, personal and based only on facts you approve, the pace stays modest and follow-ups stop when someone replies. You can read and change the wording at any time.

faqs.q: Can it send messages from my personal profile instead of a company page?
faqs.a: Yes. For consultants and agency founders, people buy from people, so outreach usually runs from the founder's or partner's own profile. You decide whose profile is used.

faqs.q: We already get referrals. Why add outreach?
faqs.a: Referrals are good leads but you cannot control when they come. Outreach adds a steady source you can switch on, so a quiet month for referrals does not leave you with an empty pipeline.

faqs.q: Do I still have to take the sales calls?
faqs.a: Yes, and you should. The agent finds the right people, sends the messages, follows up and sorts replies. Warm replies reach you on WhatsApp so you or a partner can take the discovery call.

faqs.q: How soon can we see whether it works for our firm?
faqs.a: We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days. After going live, judge it over a full month on four numbers: people reached, acceptances, real replies and booked calls.
